note: Cycle 2 (security fixes) was APPROVED. Cycle 3 reviews the Epic 4 admin UI added afterward on the same PR/branch.

review_findings.summary: Get-or-create is not concurrency-safe (SELECT-then-INSERT, no lock/unique constraint) -- two parallel calls create two 'first' drafts with identical version_number. Empirically reproduced. Blocking.
Three separate non-transactional UPDATEs with a sentinel sort_order=-1, no error checking -- a failed middle step can strand a category at -1 permanently.
Tickets #11/#12 require audited changes; profile/opening-hours/category/dish/upload mutations write no audit_logs.
Re-encoding is explicitly in #12's scope AND security section (risk:security-labelled ticket); deferring to #72 is reasonable but must not be silently marked as fully done.
MIME type is client-supplied only, no magic-byte check -- not currently exploitable (bucket allowlist + private + signed URLs) but should be hardened alongside #72's re-encoding.
MenuPage's server-render calls getOrCreateDraftMenuVersionId, writing to DB on every page load -- contributes to the race in the blocking finding.
Update actions check only `error`, not affected-row-count -- a foreign/invalid dishId reports success without writing anything.
Up/Down buttons are an acceptable Drag-Sort substitute, but focus is lost after reorder and no aria-live announcement; dishes/variants have no reorder UI at all despite a sort_order column.

required_actions: Make create_initial_draft_menu_version concurrency-safe (advisory lock or partial unique index) + concurrent integration test -- blocking merge.
Add audit logging for profile/menu/upload mutations or get explicit user sign-off on the deviation.
Explicitly flag the re-encoding scope move (#12 -> #72) in the PR/ticket, don't mark #12 fully done until then.
Add row-count checks in update actions and storage cleanup in the last upload error branch.
